Chapter 995 11: Arrival of the Qing Envoy (Please Subscribe)

"The three thousand seven hundredth Seed of the Fierce Sun."

Deep within Lin Yuan's body, another Seed of the Fierce Sun condensed, corresponding with the previous three thousand six hundred and ninety-nine Seeds.

The rules of the universe fluctuated around him, surging like a tidal wave.

"It's too exaggerated."

Lin Yuan exclaimed in amazement.

Even a pig, under such surging rule fluctuations, might have the chance to comprehend the Sixfold Realm of Space-Time.

And with a complete path, it could even strive for the ultimate Level Twelve.

What about Lin Yuan then?

"Space-time..."

Among the myriad rule fluctuations, Lin Yuan prioritized the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, but what about the Chaos Rule?

The Chaos Rule itself is born from countless rules, and enhancing it requires deeper comprehension of many rules.

"The function of the Seeds of the Fierce Sun isn't just as simple as enhancing rule comprehension."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, his expression slightly serious.

When three thousand three hundred thirty-three Seeds of the Fierce Sun had condensed, all the Seeds in his body seemed to form a cycle, causing Lin Yuan's flesh to undergo a certain transformation.

This transformation was not merely about strengthening, but was more oriented towards a transformation of the rules.

"Three thousand three hundred thirty-three Seeds of the Fierce Sun mark a significant boundary!"

Lin Yuan concluded, well aware that most beings in the Qingfen Domain knew about the thresholds of the Seeds of the Fierce Sun, separated into one seed, ten seeds, a hundred seeds...

Whether it was ten or a hundred, or even a thousand, the enhancement was only in the amplitude of rule comprehension.

But three thousand three hundred thirty-three Seeds of the Fierce Sun transformed Lin Yuan's physical body towards the ultimate direction of the rules.

Lin Yuan did not know the end point of this transformation, but he was certain it wasn't anything bad.

"Putting aside the physical transformation, my current comprehension of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule has reached the peak of the Seventh Realm, and it would take at most one year to advance."

Lin Yuan thought to himself; originally, without the help of the Seeds of the Fierce Sun, it would have taken tens of thousands of years to reach the peak of the Seventh Realm.

After condensing ten seeds, it could be achieved within a thousand years.

Now? With the support of three thousand seven hundred Seeds of the Fierce Sun, Lin Yuan was certain that he could reach the peak of the Seventh Realm of Space-Time within a year.

Perhaps even the Eighth Realm of Space-Time could be reached in a short time.

"However, condensing new Seeds of the Fierce Sun now seems much more difficult than when I started," Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Starting from the three thousand three hundred thirty-fourth Seed of the Fierce Sun, the difficulty of condensing each seed massively increased.

Whereas Lin Yuan could condense a Seed of the Fierce Sun between breaths, now he needed ten breaths, or even a hundred, to do so.

"The next significant threshold for the Seeds of the Fierce Sun should be thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three seeds. I wonder what capabilities it will bring."

Lin Yuan speculated in his mind; from the current situation, three thousand three hundred thirty-three Seeds could form a minor cycle.

And thirty-three thousand three hundred thirty-three Seeds could form a major cycle.

...

The condensation of the Seeds of the Fierce Sun mainly tests comprehension, each Seed is incredibly complex, and one must fully understand it before condensing it.

"However," the Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method "can only be practiced in this original world."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Even his incarnation in the Chaos Void had tried to condense the Seeds of the Fierce Sun.

But the result was unsurprisingly a failure,

It wasn't really a failure, as the Seeds of the Fierce Sun were eventually condensed,

But they were significantly different from the Seeds he was currently condensing, and they also lacked the effect of enhancing rule comprehension.

"Is it because of the Ancestor of the Fierce Sun? Or that eternal Fierce Sun?"

Lin Yuan looked up at the sky, at the eternal Fierce Sun radiating endless light and heat, his thoughts fluctuating.

This original world's Fierce Sun is not a star in the Cosmic Starry Skies; they are completely different concepts. The eternal Fierce Sun in the sky has almost become regulated, omnipresent, and unstoppable.

"Let's first condense more Seeds of the Fierce Sun."

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts; these past few months, he had been re-cultivating Martial Tao and condensing Seeds of the Fierce Sun, while also perceiving the unique rule fluctuations of this Fang Yuan World.

The rule fluctuations of this Fang Yuan World are different from the Chaos Void; reintegrating Martial Tao needed some consideration, but it wasn't a big problem.

...

Main Universe.

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan is sitting cross-legged.

The universe within his body, after over a hundred years of adjustments, has undergone earth-shattering changes.

In the Fang Yuan World, several months have passed, but for the Main Universe, it has been over a hundred years.

The universe inside his body.

Vast, spanning over millions of light-years.

The current universe inside his body, every inch of space bears extreme spacetime pressure.

In the Main Universe, Level Eleven beings who have comprehended the Rule of Time can freely manipulate the speed of time flow, achieving the scenario where thousands of years pass by in the outside world, but only a moment passes for them.

It's akin to an alternative method of extending life.

But now?

Forget about Level Eleven beings who have comprehended the Rule of Time, even those whose Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule has reached the Fifth Realm of Level Eleven Perfect, their influence of the time flow is much less, only able to control up to several dozens of times the speed.

The same applies to space, Level Nine Evolvers in the Main Universe can easily occupy tens of thousands, or even millions, of Spatial Layers.

But here, it is not so easy; Level Nine beings are also known as Multi-Spatial Life, yet the number of Spatial Layers they can occupy in this internal universe has been greatly reduced.

Simply put, the current space-time in Lin Yuan's inner universe is extremely precise and even somewhat harsh.

"My current inner universe..."
